Mykolayiv Old Peski Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Mykolaivska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is Mykolaiv's older 'Peski' Jewish cemetery — the source of the burials transferred to the city's New (Internatsional'ne) cemetery when this site was closed in 1874. It had vanished from maps by 1941, suggesting it was demolished well before WWII, unusually early compared to most cemeteries in this collection destroyed during or after the war. It served the same large Jewish community documented at the New cemetery, which peaked above 25,000 people before the Holocaust; blocks of flats, other buildings, and a tram depot now occupy the site.
